summary.text: Ruben Gallego was elected to the U.S. Senate from Arizona in November 2024 and sworn in on January 3, 2025.

paragraphs.text: He previously served in the Arizona House of Representatives, elected in 2010, and in the U.S. House of Representatives after his election in 2014.
He graduated from Harvard University, enlisted in the Marine Corps, and deployed to Iraq in 2005 as an infantryman with Lima Company, 3rd Battalion, 25th Marines.
He lives in South Phoenix with his wife and three children.
